fix_subject: Resolve partition columns for non-pushdown table functions

labels.summary: Partitioned aggregate planning for table functions with projection_pushdown disabled indexed already-resolved base-column indices through the narrowed column_ids a second time, which either checked partition info for the wrong column or threw an out-of-range internal error at plan time; the fix uses the indices directly for non-pushdown scans and bounds-checks before indexing so the optimization is declined instead.
